_documentation: Single source of truth for the public calendar feeds AND the home-page event cards (#249). Two consumers: (a) `scripts/build-calendar.py` generates `calendar.ics` + `calendar/<slug>.ics` from the top-level scheduling fields (`uid`, `summary`, `description`, `start`, `end`, `location`, `url`, `organizer`, `categories`, `status`); see `docs/architecture.md` *Adding a new event*. (b) The inline JS renderer in `index.html` (+ FR + DE) reads the *renderer* fields (`eventType`, `featured`, `displayDate`, `i18n`, `meta`, `cta`) to build the event cards on the home page. EN content comes from the canonical top-level `summary` + `description` (also used by the .ics); FR + DE overrides live under `i18n.{fr,de}`. The renderer falls back to EN if a locale block is missing, and the hand-coded HTML in each home page is preserved as a `<noscript>`-style fail-soft fallback that the renderer empties on success. When you edit an event here: bump `dtstamp`, run `python3 scripts/build-calendar.py`, and confirm the FR/DE i18n blocks track any EN copy changes. CI runs the drift checker on every PR. Two Indico-derived markers (set by scripts/sync-indico.py, see docs/indico-sync.md): `coHost` is 'joint' for jointly-run EISS × NetSec events (the renderer shows a 'Joint EISS × NetSec' pill) and 'standalone' / absent otherwise; `autoDiscovered: true` flags an entry the sync appended from NetSec's Indico category (#8) carrying only EN copy, to be hand-enriched (richer description, FR/DE) by the maintainer. (c) A third consumer, `assets/js/working-groups.js`, builds the *Related events* cards in each Working Group section from `workingGroups`, `eventType`, `cardTitle`, the optional `cardSubtitle` (a themed strand title, e.g. the policy workshop's), `cardLocation` (a short city-level place, or a localised 'venue to be confirmed' line), `displayDate` and `cta`. Cards run earliest-first, ordered on `start`.

events.description:
Three days of training and mentoring for early-career researchers in European security: research presentations, individualised feedback from senior scholars, and structured mentorship. Open to PhD candidates and post-docs (within one year of defence) in strategic studies and international security, as well as SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS alumni.

Scientific Coordinators: Dr Silvia D'Amato, Prof Chiara Ruffa.

Full details: https://netsec-cost.eu/summer-school.html

cardDescription.en: Three days of training and mentoring for early-career researchers in European security: research presentations, individualised feedback from senior scholars, and structured mentorship. Open to PhD candidates and post-docs (within one year of defence) in strategic studies and international security, as well as SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS alumni. Travel and hotel reimbursement is available for 15 PhD students, and selected participants receive free access to the European Security Conference that follows.

Ouverte aux doctorant·es et post-doctorant·es (dans l'année suivant la soutenance) en études stratégiques et sécurité internationale, ainsi qu'aux alumni SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS. Remboursement des frais de voyage et d'hôtel pour 15 doctorant·es, et accès gratuit à la European Security Conference qui suit pour les participant·es sélectionné·es.

events.summary: NetSec Policy Workshop: Great Power Politics and the Future of Alliances
events.description:
A NetSec Working Group 2 policy workshop on great power politics and the future of alliances, convening scholars and policy practitioners to examine how alliance politics is evolving under intensifying great power competition, and what the implications are for European security.

Accommodation in Ankara and all meals are provided by Bilkent University and the Royal Danish Defence College. NetSec plans to reimburse accepted participants' travel costs through COST Action NetSec up to a maximum of €700 per participant, pending a decision by NetSec's Management Committee.

Applications close 15 August 2026. Full details and the application form: https://netsec-cost.eu/policy-workshop-2026.html

cardDescription.en: Working Group 2's one-day policy workshop on great power politics and the future of alliances, at Bilkent University, Ankara. Accommodation and meals are covered, and travel reimbursement up to €700 is planned, pending Management Committee approval. Applications close 15 August 2026.
cardDescription.fr: L'atelier politique d'une journée du Groupe de travail 2 sur les grandes puissances et l'avenir des alliances, à l'Université Bilkent, Ankara. L'hébergement et les repas sont pris en charge, et un remboursement des déplacements jusqu'à 700 € est prévu, sous réserve de l'approbation du Comité de gestion. Candidatures jusqu'au 15 août 2026.
cardDescription.de: Der eintägige Politik-Workshop der Arbeitsgruppe 2 zu Großmachtpolitik und der Zukunft der Bündnisse an der Bilkent-Universität, Ankara. Unterkunft und Verpflegung werden übernommen, eine Reisekostenerstattung bis 700 € ist vorbehaltlich der Zustimmung des Management Committee geplant. Bewerbungen bis 15. August 2026.

events.description:
The Action's first formal Management Committee plenary, bringing together the MC representatives from the participating COST Member countries to align on workstreams, confirm Working Group leadership for the coming cycle, and elect any remaining roles. Followed by a Core Group working session.

Access is restricted to MC representatives, Working Group leads, and invited observers.

cardDescription.en: The Action's first formal plenary meeting, bringing together Management Committee representatives and Working Group leads to align on workstreams, confirm leadership for the coming cycle, and elect any remaining roles. The Action officially started on 10 October 2025; this is the first in-person plenary.
cardDescription.fr: La première réunion plénière formelle de l'Action, rassemblant les représentant·es du Comité de gestion et les responsables des groupes de travail pour s'aligner sur les chantiers, confirmer les positions de direction pour le cycle à venir et élire les rôles restants. L'Action a officiellement débuté le 10 octobre 2025 ; il s'agit de la première plénière en présentiel.
cardDescription.de: Die erste formelle Plenarsitzung der Aktion, die die Vertreter·innen des Management-Ausschusses und die Arbeitsgruppen-Leitungen zusammenbringt, um die Arbeitsstränge abzustimmen, die Leitung für den kommenden Zyklus zu bestätigen und verbleibende Rollen zu wählen. Die Aktion startete offiziell am 10. Oktober 2025; dies ist das erste Plenum vor Ort.
